name: Baffinland Mary River Iron Mine Expansion
description: Baffinland Iron Mines Corporation's proposed expansion of the Mary River iron ore mine on Baffin Island, facing opposition from Inuit hunters, trappers, and environmental groups over projected impacts on caribou and narwhal populations.

sources.title: Yellowknifer — Baffinland mine expansion encounters opposition from hunters and trappers, environmental groups, May 2026
Yellowknifer — Baffinland can't pay back its debts, but iron mine will continue operating for now, May 2026

name: Hope Bay Gold Mine Redevelopment
description: Agnico Eagle is beginning the redevelopment of the Hope Bay gold mine in Canada's Arctic. The project is expected to support close to 2,000 jobs for indigenous groups in the region and increase Canadian gold exports by US$1.89-billion, according to Natural Resources Canada.

sources.title: Globe and Mail Business — Agnico Eagle to begin redevelopment of Hope Bay gold mine in Canada's Arctic, May 2026

name: Hope Bay Mine Redevelopment
description: Redevelopment and re-establishment of the Hope Bay gold mining project in Canada's North, Nunavut, with a groundbreaking ceremony attended by Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Tim Hodgson on May 19, 2026. The project represents a major milestone for Arctic resource development.

sources.title: Natural Resources Canada — Government of Canada marks groundbreaking at Hope Bay Mine, May 2026

name: Nunavut Infrastructure and Economic Development Projects
description: The Government of Canada announced $13M in funding for four infrastructure and economic development projects across Nunavut, supporting community infrastructure and economic growth in the territory.

evidence.name: ReNew Canada — Canada invests $13M in four Nunavut infrastructure and economic projects, April 2026

sources.title: ReNew Canada — Canada invests $13M in four Nunavut infrastructure and economic projects, April 2026

name: Canada's Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar Project
description: A NORAD modernization initiative to design and build Arctic over-the-horizon radar infrastructure, awarded to a consortium of Pomerleau, Aecon, and Stantec under an alternative delivery model to strengthen Canadian sovereignty and continental defence.

sources.title: On-Site Magazine — Pomerleau, Aecon and Stantec to lead development of Canada's Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar project, April 2026

name: Iqaluit Northern Infrastructure Projects
description: Iqaluit, Nunavut is identified as a beneficiary of the national infrastructure fund, receiving a significant boost for capital infrastructure projects in the community.

sources.title: On-Site Magazine — Northern projects receive massive boost through national infrastructure fund, April 2026

name: Northern Communities Infrastructure Fund — Iqaluit, Hay River, Whitehorse
description: Iqaluit (Nunavut), Hay River (Northwest Territories), and Whitehorse (Yukon) are among communities receiving infrastructure project funding through a national infrastructure fund targeting northern and territorial communities.

sources.title: On-Site Magazine — Northern projects receive massive boost through national infrastructure fund, Apr 2026

name: Small Craft Harbours Program — Iqaluit Investments
description: The Government of Canada announced historic investments in Fisheries and Oceans Canada's Small Craft Harbours Program, highlighted in Iqaluit as part of the Spring Economic Update 2026. Secretary of State Stephanie McLean travelled to Iqaluit to announce the funding for harbour infrastructure.
